description: Biogeochemically coupled (BGC) version of `esm-flat10`. Driven by prescribed CO2 concentration taken from the `esm-flat10` simulation of the ESM. All other conditions are kept the same as `piControl`. This provides the opportunity to diagnose climate-carbon cycle feedbacks from the `esm-flat10` simulations because it uses identical CO2 concentration. Complements `flat10-rad`.
branch_information: Run exactly parallel to the esm-flat10 simulations. Branch from the same point of `esm-piControl`.
